canonical_assertion: Native default: one persistent native geometric state uses one declared integer or fixed-point representation for token addresses, vector coordinates, carry, routes, memory keys and reads, learned state, gradients and optimizer updates; training and serving use the same typed operators; route choices, carry state, read choices, memory addresses and token ids are bit-identical on the same prompt and starting state; the artifact losslessly serializes that state instead of an F32 master model or an export gap; floating point remains reference or diagnostic code only.
decision_suffix: The historical float/export systems and evidence are preserved but are no longer the default route. Amends §1, §2.1, §3.6 and replaces the default-path meaning of §3.7.
model_status: **D85 status:** the persistent native state/operator implementation is pending; all float-to-integer measurements on this page are historical/export evidence.
